status: Available style specification; final outputs require format-specific visual checks
source: Original interpretations of style names demonstrated in a user-supplied video; not recovered source code.
quality_checks: Readable text and measured contrast against rendered colors
No information communicated by color alone
Responsive layout with no horizontal overflow
Content remains readable without blur or animation

motion.reduced_motion: Remove decorative movement and nonessential transitions

name: Wireframe 3D
summary: Structure-first thinking rendered as light technical geometry.
use_when: Use for technical concepts, system architecture introductions, and process prototypes.
avoid_when: Use sparingly in dense reading and preserve stable, high-contrast text surfaces.
typography: System monospace for headings; system sans-serif for body.
layout: Geometric wireframe decoration, thin rules, and structured panels.
surfaces: Cyan-green line grids, technical frames, matte dark content blocks.
exclude: Decorative measurements presented as real data

adaptations.web: Use the tokens and live components; validate keyboard, mobile, contrast, and reduced motion.
adaptations.slides: Preserve hierarchy and palette with native editable shapes and text. Replace motion with static emphasis.
adaptations.documents: Use native headings, readable body text, restrained callouts, and solid reading surfaces.
adaptations.images: Describe composition and material cues; check text and layout separately. Do not claim pixel-exact token fidelity.

prompt: Apply Wireframe 3D to [DELIVERABLE] for [AUDIENCE]. Purpose: [GOAL]. Preserve all supplied content, existing visuals, and required brand constraints. System monospace for headings; system sans-serif for body. Geometric wireframe decoration, thin rules, and structured panels. Cyan-green line grids, technical frames, matte dark content blocks. Palette: background #081b20, surface #102b30, text #edfffa, muted #aed4cb, accent #83ead4, border #497e74. Essential traits: Wire geometry; Technical section markers; Stable solid reading surfaces. Avoid: Lines crossing text; Overly dense meshes; Decorative measurements presented as real data. Keep motion restrained and optional, respect reduced motion, and provide a static fallback. Adapt the appearance to the requested output format. Keep text legible, controls accessible, and content editable where supported. Resolve mandatory brand conflicts explicitly. Return the design and accurately report performed and unperformed checks.
